chunks: He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me, he said: Abul Fadl Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Tusi (may God have mercy on him) reported to us, he said: Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal reported to us, he said: Ali ibn Hakim al-Awdi reported to us, he said: Sharik informed us, from Uthman ibn Abi Zar'ah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, who said:

Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari was asked -- and his eyebrows had fallen over his eyes -- and it was said to him: "Tell us about Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him." He lifted his eyebrows with his hands, then said: "He is the best of all creatures; no one hates him but a hypocrite, and no one doubts in him except an infidel."

key_terms.البرية: All creation, all creatures -- signifying Ali's supreme rank among creation
key_terms.كافر: Disbeliever (kafir) -- one who rejects the truth
key_terms.منافق: Hypocrite (munafiq) -- one who outwardly professes faith but conceals disbelief

ai.seo_question: What did Jabir ibn Abdillah say about Ali ibn Abi Talib?
ai.summary: This narration records the testimony of the Prophet's eminent companion Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari about Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS). Asked in his extreme old age -- when his eyebrows had drooped over his eyes -- Jabir emphatically declared Ali to be the best of creation, stating that only a hypocrite would hate him and only a disbeliever would doubt him. This testimony carries special weight as Jabir was one of the last surviving companions and a direct witness to the Prophet's own declarations about Ali.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 7. He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Abul Fadhl Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Tusi (may Allah bless him with mercy) who reported from Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Hakim al-Awadi, who reported from Sharik, from Uthman ibn Abu Zara’h, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja’d that:

Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari was once asked, (during his old age) when his eyebrows had fallen over his eyes: "Tell us about ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him." Jabir lifted his eyebrows with his hands and said: "He is the best of all creatures, no one hates him but a hypocrite and no one doubts in him except an infidel."
